tess: heads-up: i'm putting together an RFC for a runtime hint + probe-budget approach to reduce probe fanout for high-qps tenants. short goal: drop median probes by ~30% without increasing route-miss or p95 latency.
omar: sounds promising. quick ask: what are the invariants the runtime must preserve vs compiler?
tess: runtime can only do conservative, idempotent filters: region, tenant-tier, simple capacity flags. it must never rule out a route that the compiled policy marks as strictly required. compiler remains the source of truth.
nora: rollout safety? this smells risky if snapshots diverge.
tess: plan: shadow mode for 2 weeks (runtime emits what-would-have-filtered), then tenant-scoped canary, then broader. snapshots signed + versioned; runtime rejects stale deltas and falls back to no-filter.
kevin: metrics to monitor? include `probes_per_request`, `probe_latency_p95`, `route_miss_after_filter`, `false_filter_count`, `budget_enforced_rate`, `exhaustive_trim_rate`. gate expansion on `false_filter_count < 0.01%` and `exhaustive_trim_rate < 0.05%`.
omar: budget calculation idea?
tess: budget = clamp(base=6 * sla_multiplier * tenant_multiplier, min=2, max=12). reduce budget by recent cache_hit_ratio. hedged requests bypass budget but consume `hedge_quota`.
nora: debug tools for oncall?
tess: add /internal/debug/route_eval that returns (shadow) candidate list + decision reasons + snapshot_id. log decision_sig + snapshot_hash on each filtered request.
kevin: ops: add kill-switch config `runtime.hints.enabled = false` and `runtime.hints.force_allow_all` for emergencies. also `snapshot_ttl` default 60s.
deploy-bot: deploy-check: canary must enable 100% trace sampling and `hint_shadow_mode=true` for 48h before enforcement.
omar: one more: avoid oscillation when snapshots update rapidly. add hysteresis window `hysteresis_ms=500`.
tess: will include a simple API example and a compact hint encoding in the RFC. sample API:
POST /v1/runtime/evaluate_hint body: {"tenant":"t-acme","model":"open-7b","sla":"p95-200ms","region":"us-west","schema_v":1} resp: {"candidates":["r1","r3"],"budget":6,"reason_codes":["region","tier_ok"],"snapshot_id":"s-2026-03-01"}
omar: include `debug=true` to return full compiled candidates in shadow.
nora: add `white_list` for tenants to skip filters. and infra ticket to reuse probe-cache.	tess: noted. i'll draft the RFC with the simulation plan (72h replay), dashboards, gating thresholds, and staged rollout. targeting arch sync next Tue.
kevin: :thumbsup: thanks, excited to see shadow numbers.
deploy-bot: ticket created: INFRA-4950 "runtime-hint-probe-budget" https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INFRA-4950
